title: Models
description: The five frozen models side by side. Per gameweek: each model's pre-deadline advice, recorded before the deadline by the prospective harness, and — once the gameweek is finished — the points it actually scored (final XI after auto-subs, armband with vice fallback, minus hits). Live advice is the champion's alone; every other model is a comparison. Absent until the harness has recorded a decision, so like log.json its absence is a normal published state.

as_of.description: UTC instant of the input snapshot the advice was decided on (ORC-03, DL-94). Absent before R1.3.0.

trigger.description: What started the run: the schedule, a change of the named kinds, a manual dispatch or the day-before refresh (ORC-03). Absent before R1.3.0.

champion.description: The model id whose advice is live.

switch_gameweek.description: The first gameweek recorded live. Earlier gameweeks are the retired frozen harness's virtual seasons; later ones are each strategy's advice on the owner's real squad (DL-87, DL-89). Null when the frozen record decided nothing. Absent means null.

provisional.description: True when the latest gameweek is a provisional preview (no frozen decision yet). Absent means false.

id.description: The strategy's id in the strategy registry (strategies.json).

key.description: The frozen harness's key for this strategy, one of its registry aliases.

available.description: Whether the latest gameweek's advice passed the CI input-freshness check.

unavailable_reason.description: Why not, shown verbatim in the app.

provisional.description: The latest advice is a provisional preview that freezes at the decision window. Absent means false.

sources.description: The sources whose missing data left the strategy without advice, by the labels the data health page uses (ORC-07). Absent when it is not waiting for a source.

since.description: UTC instant of the first run in this gameweek that found the source's data missing (ORC-07).

next_check.description: When the source is next fetched: the next fast-ingest firing before the deadline, which GitHub may drop. Null for a gameweek no longer Open, or none before its deadline (ORC-07).

as_of.description: UTC instant of the input snapshot the advice was decided on (ORC-03, DL-94). Absent before R1.3.0.

trigger.description: What started the run: the schedule, a change of the named kinds, a manual dispatch or the day-before refresh (ORC-03). Absent before R1.3.0.

expected_points.description: xPts of the XI with the armband, net of hits.

option_set.description: The options the model weighed at the deadline on its predicted xP, from the ledger's advice of record (ORC-11), for setting beside the hindsight optimum. Absent for frozen gameweeks and advice recorded before R1.4.0.

underlying_points.description: The same final XI and armband, before hits, scored on each player's underlying expected points: the game's rules applied to his minutes and FPL's expected goals, assists and goals conceded (ORC-12). Absent for the frozen record and before evaluation version 4.

forecast_error.description: The advice's xP less underlying_points: what the forecast missed by. Absent with underlying_points.

luck.description: points_before_hits less underlying_points: positive when the XI scored more than its chances were worth. xP less points is forecast_error less luck. Absent with underlying_points.

availability.description: Per model: did every input it needs pass the freshness check for this decision? Advice and points appear only for models that did (fail closed).

actual.description: Null until the gameweek is finished and scored.

record.description: Where this gameweek's advice and points come from: the retired frozen harness, or the live ledger scored on the owner's real squad. Absent means frozen.

provisional.description: A dry-run preview of current advice, published before the frozen decision exists and replaced by it at the decision window. Never scored. Absent means false.

log_hindsight_optimal.description: Every option a transfer solve weighed: the roll, the best single transfer and the best overall. The hindsight solves it on realised points (whole); each model's decision on its predicted xP (ORC-11). The same definition is in week.schema.json and models.schema.json, and the type generator fails if they differ.
